title: Generic ambient Brown data for the localizing closure
statement: For every scheme X and commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ, the localizing closure from [sk-def-localizing-closure] is locally small, triangulated, closed under isomorphisms, has coproducts in the fixed universe, and is idempotent complete. No base-field finiteness or coefficient admissibility assumption is needed.

proof.text: Apply the generic localizing-closure existence theorem for ambient coproducts and the localizing property. The full inclusion gives local smallness. Restrict coproduct closure along the equivalence with a lifted discrete indexing type and apply countable-coproduct idempotent completeness.

          IsIdempotentComplete (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory ∧
